intent_detection.note: Intent and framing determine every downstream stage, so even the fast tier uses the stronger model with a small output budget.

research_planning.note: Fast changes evidence volume and depth, not the quality of the research framing.

intent_detection.note: The senior academic tier uses a stronger model once to classify the research problem and propose topic-specific framing before planning.

research_planning.note: The strong model remains responsible for framing, while low reasoning preserves output space for the complete structured plan and avoids paying for repeated truncated JSON.

content_generation.note: Evidence extraction, report filling and claim extraction use explicit contracts; disabling hidden reasoning preserves the bounded output budget for deliverable JSON.

high_risk_verification.note: Flash verifies ordinary claims. Only the task-level Top 10 priority claims upgrade to Pro; deterministic scoping preserves the output budget for auditable verdicts.

ppt_storyboard.note: The strong-model research plan already defines the story; P6 spends its budget on complete page content, visuals and citations.

notes: Model IDs and prices were checked against official DeepSeek API documentation on 2026-10-08 and must be rechecked before launch.
Deterministic validation should not be delegated to a language model.
Cost reduction must never weaken citation authenticity.
